description: Scrape rental listings from Apartments.com. Use 'search' mode to find listings by location, or 'urls' mode to scrape specific pages.

amenities.description: Only show listings with these amenities.
amenities.title: Required Amenities

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to return (1–500).
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPages.description: Maximum number of search result pages to scrape (1–20). Each page has ~25 listings.
maxPages.title: Max Search Pages

mode.description: How to find listings: 'search' builds a URL from your location and filters; 'urls' scrapes the Apartments.com URLs you provide.
mode.title: Mode

priceMax.description: Maximum monthly rent in USD. Leave unset for no maximum.
priceMax.title: Maximum Monthly Rent ($)

priceMin.description: Minimum monthly rent in USD. Leave unset for no minimum.
priceMin.title: Minimum Monthly Rent ($)

rentSpecials.description: Only show listings with current rent specials or move-in deals.
rentSpecials.title: Rent Specials Only

scrapeDetails.description: Visit each listing's detail page to get full amenities, description, scores, floor plans, and contact info. Slower but richer data.
scrapeDetails.title: Scrape Full Listing Details

searchLocation.description: City and state to search (e.g. 'New York, NY', 'Los Angeles, CA', 'Chicago, IL', 'Austin, TX'). Used only in 'search' mode.
searchLocation.sectionDescription: Filters applied when mode=search. Ignored when mode=urls.
searchLocation.title: Search Location

startUrls.description: Apartments.com search result page URLs or individual listing URLs. Used only in 'urls' mode.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Provide Apartments.com URLs directly when mode=urls.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

title: Apartments.com Scraper Input
